result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders. In `findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 6517), I added `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery. That is the same filter the other purchase-order queries use.

Reps with no purchase orders in the period are still listed with 0, and the highest-count-first ordering is unchanged.

The `*SalesRep*` tests ran and passed, but I didn't add a test for the cancelled case. So your Anna 2 / Bob 1 example isn't checked by a test.
